description: With claude.model-level-cooling (the new core's model_level_cooling account setting) a refused shared 5-hour window blocks only the model that hit it: the account still serves its other model. A third request, for the model that hit the limit, is answered without calling the upstream.

exceptions.reason: A Messages request goes to Claude unchanged (passthrough): today's Claude API-key provider rewrites it: it adds cache_control breakpoints when the body has none, removes the thinking setting and thinking blocks for models missing from its catalog, sets stream false on a non-streamed request and drops a 1h cache TTL that follows a 5m one. The new core keeps the client's body, thinking blocks, signatures and cache markers as sent; a Claude Code client places its own breakpoints.

Go's HTTP client asks for gzip and decodes it; today's core also offers deflate, br and zstd.

The Claude extension sends an API key in x-api-key, as Anthropic's API defines it; today's core sends it as a bearer token whenever the base URL is not api.anthropic.com (it uses x-api-key only there).

When every account is cooling, today's core names the model, provider and last upstream error in its own message; the new core says the model and the wait in its message and gives the wait as Retry-After.
